meta.title: Notification sound
meta.description: Plays a sound on the host machine whenever DSH raises a permission/approval request or a question that needs your choice, so you notice it even when the browser tab is unfocused (still subject to the host's system volume/mute). Configure the sound (built-in chime or the system sound), toggle each trigger, and set a minimum interval between sounds (cooldown). Sound only — it never answers or alters any request or question. Supports Windows / macOS / Linux; a silent no-op on other platforms.
